title: A current supported in an n-plane with a nonzero constant-multiplicity mass formula has the whole plane as support
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, ℝ^P = Euclid P), every orthonormal family τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) in ℝ^P (Orthonormal ℝ τ) with Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n} (Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)), and every c ∈ ℤ: if spt C ⊆ Q, M_W(C) = |c|·H^n(W ∩ Q) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P (C.massOn W = c.natAbs · μHE[n](W ∩ Q) in [0, ∞]), and M_W(C) ≠ 0 for some open W ⊆ ℝ^P, then spt C = Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (c : ℤ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C.massOn W = (c.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (W ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)))) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ C.massOn W ≠ 0) → C.support = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))
